title: Canvas Learning Apps catalog includes Turnitin and Respondus LockDown Browser/Monitor webcam proctoring
summary: The public Canvas Learning Apps page describes Turnitin (integrity/plagiarism/grading) and Respondus LockDown Browser and Monitor, which locks the test environment and uses the student's webcam for auto-proctoring. Webcam proctoring is a high-sensitivity surveillance capability sitting inside the LMS app ecosystem.
student_action: Before a proctored exam, demand written notice of what is recorded, retained, and who can review it.
school_action: Require course-level notice, retention limits, and alternatives when biometric/webcam monitoring is used.
